cannotAnswer.why: Every family on these surfaces is blocked on a source that does not exist, so none of them can produce a page to publish.
cannotAnswer.consequence: This cohort measures whether the machine works. It does not measure whether the programme is right, because no high priority family is in it.

honestSummary: Not one page in this cohort is from a high priority family. That is not a design choice, it is what the source gate permits today, and it is the strongest argument in the programme for spending the next unit of effort on data licensing rather than on more keyword research.
